Austin is described as a naive empiricist because his account of law rests on an anachronistic model of a legal system, the sovereign-commands-and-habitual-obedience picture that Hart later criticised as too simple for modern law. I can't check this against a source here, so treat it as my best reading of the candidate answers rather than a verified quotation. The other candidate, that he conceives of laws pragmatically rather than conceptually, fits less well with the empiricist label.

CONFIDENCE: 45
